text: This app is absolutely amazing. In fact I'm using it right now writing this review! The whole reason I first got my cell phone (or smartphone originally) was because I learned of the feature of being able to talk into my phone. Since then this is the next best thing that's ever happened to me regarding a smartphone. To be able to talk and not have to edit every single little thing, it's absolutely amazing. I love it. I can't recommend it highly enough!
